title: PriorityChef Mortar and Pestle Set, Heavy Duty Natural Granite, Make Fresh Guacamole at Home, Solid Stone Grinder Bowl, Herb Crusher, Spice Grinder, 1.5 Cup Size, Unpolished Grey
description:
About this item
Mortar and Pestle Set
reviews_5s:
I like that it is heavy and stable. Comes with a stick-on rubber pad and an extra, to keep it from slipping or scratching your counters.
The pestle is also substantial and really does the job and comfortable to hold. They also included a slip on rubber grip for the pestle if you need it, but mostly we don't use that. If I were to do a lot of grinding in a single session I might use it to give my hand some padding.
We mostly use it (so far) for grinding spices. The granite is the perfect surface as it has a bit of texture so the spices don't just slide around as you try to grind as the do on my previous stainless steel one.
Follow the instructions to season it first and you will have excellent results!Exactly what I needed, perfect size - not big, but medium size perfect for grinding spices, mashing garlic, etc. Stone is nice a rough for quick breaking down of whatever you put in it. It looks nice on the shelf and doesn't take up a lot of space.prompt, great instructions, solid, well designedBeautiful and perfect out the box! I have not used it yet but will update soon. It's very heavy and sturdy.This is very heavy. The instructions to season it were very clear. I made guacamole and it was delicious. Cleanup was a breezeThis is working great. My husband was jazzed to get it. It looks Great, is heavy, it does have a non slip pad on the bottom which helps prevent scratching too which is great. He has been grinding spices no for the marinade and I can tell a difference so this has been very good for flavoring now too! Happy with it.This is the first mortar and pestle I've ever owned, and I'm quite pleased with it. The initial seasoning by crushing white rice took awhile, and honestly my arm got sore because I hadn't figured out yet that it's about finding a correct pace instead of just going as fast as possible. After that it's been a breeze, easy for spices, easy cleanup, etc. Not sure everyone gets one or if it was a limited time thing, but my package also included a garlic peeler described as a "free gift." How nice is that?I love this mortar! It makes it so much easier to crush garlic or grind anything. Its weight and shape are perfect — a great help in the kitchenI have cured and cleaned this item, I’ve used it vigorously, now I have made many dips and concoctions the best thing is the all around satisfaction I have got out of it! Love this motor and pedestal!Just make sure you follow the instructions. I like the look and the feel of it, quite heavy so be careful
reviews_1s:
Followed ll the directions for this unsealed mortar and pestal but it always felt gritty and honestly awful to the touch. Did not trust it to use with food.I was sent a used item. It was dirty and items were missing that had been in the box.I agree with some of the other critical reviews. Mine came broken, dusty and dirty in the box and I use the term box loosely. This box was not constructed well, sides were split, the top was torn off and the mortar was falling out of the box even before I opened the package it came in. The pestle was broken in half and the mortar was chipped at the bottom. Also, the little pads they sent to protect your countertop from scratches were nothing more than black pieces of paper. Of course, this is stone and it's going to be dirty to some degree but it felt like they made it, let it dry and threw it in a box.

I packaged the mortar and pestle back up, better than I got it, and returned it the next day.
